title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins deploy and govern MCP-based agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: Hold for corrections to licensing and the scope of server blocking. Microsoft lists core tenant-wide MCP tool governance as included with Microsoft cloud subscriptions, rather than mixed entitlement; its updated guidance also limits blocking to governed pathways for MCP servers generally, not just bring-your-own servers. The listed admin routes and preview configuration API operations are supported, with minor qualifications needed.
